description: D12 OC Bikeways is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The D12 Park and Ride Map App provides park and ride lots information and other transportation facilities information within Caltrans District 12. Caltrans will continue to explore opportunities to increase the number of Park and Ride facilities through coordination with OCTA, local jurisdictions, and private property owners to identify additional suitable sites. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are D12, ParkandRide, Park, Ride, Highway, Clearinghouse. The bounding box given is -118.1146,33.3949,-117.4583,33.9468. The hub shows 2023-02-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
